item.title: Rock River Trail Celebrating America’s 250th with Liberty Oak Sapling Giveaway - The Radar Free Press
item.description: In 2026, the Rock River Trail invites you to plant a Liberty Oak tree to celebrate 250 years of the founding of our country.

item.title: Lee County Sheriff’s Office Investigates Theft and Arrests Three Individuals - The Radar Free Press
item.description: On Sunday evening, March 22nd, Deputies with the Lee County Sheriff’s Office arrested Bryan Kettley, age 26, of Dixon, and Codi Despain, age 20, of Dixon, following an investigation into a theft at the Nelson Township Building.

item.title: Along the Rock: S3 Ep 42-Creating Art That Heals | A Conversation with Brian Dixon - The Radar Free Press
item.description: On this episode of Along the Rock, host Nathan Stahr welcomes back a familiar face to the studio—artist and community contributor Brian Dixon. Known locally for his involvement with Granny Rose Animal Shelter, Brian returns not to spotlight adoptable pets but to share a deeply personal journey that has reshaped his life and creative path.

item.title: Discover Dixon Announces 2026 Downtown Banner Program Featuring America 250 Theme - The Radar Free Press
item.description: Discover Dixon announces the launch of its 2026 Downtown Banner Program, inspired by the upcoming America 250 celebration.

item.title: Christ Lutheran School to Host Americana Trivia Night Fundraiser - The Radar Free Press
item.description: Christ Lutheran School will host an Americana Trivia Night on Saturday, April 25, 2026, at Sauk Valley Community College’s Dillon Mall, 173 Illinois Route 2 in Dixon.

item.title: Along the Rock: S3 Ep 43-Supporting our Community One Meal at a Time | Feed Our People Fundraiser - The Radar Free Press
item.description: On this episode of Along the Rock, host Nathan Stahr connects with Kassy Wells, director of the Helping Hands Food Pantry, to shed light on the growing need for food assistance and the local community's powerful ways of stepping up to help.

item.title: “What Were You Wearing?” Exhibit Aims to Challenge Sexual Assault Misconceptions at SVCC - The Radar Free Press
item.description: An exhibit aimed at challenging misconceptions surrounding sexual assault will be on display April 6–8 at the west mall entrance on the Sauk Valley Community College campus.
